archetypes.name: score-parity
archetypes.rationale: Score changes span three tally paths and legacy TSV fallback.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the voting, plan-review, and code-review scoreboard math for parity. Check that only in-scope neutral rows receive the -0.25 penalty, OOS neutral rows stay at zero, and integer scores still render without a trailing decimal. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-drift
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer prompt prose is generated from both templates and hand-maintained specialists.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the prompt and documentation updates for drift. Confirm that template-derived agents and pre-rendered bodies were regenerated, hand-maintained specialists match the new economics, and OOS guidance remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
